name: Physical Sciences (BS)
intro: This program is intended for students with an interest in the physical sciences. The program is designed to allow students interested in teaching at the secondary level to enroll in courses required for the California Single Subject Teaching credential offered through the School of Education.

courses.title: Fundamentals of Physics I: Mechanics, Oscillations and Waves
Fundamentals of Physics II: Electricity and Magnetism
Fundamentals of Physics III: Optics, Thermo, Modern Physics

notes: Three additional electives from these fields* Units: 12
